gaps: No order or advisory opened says whether motorcycles are allowed when the road reopens for light motor vehicles.
No source found for the usual number of days riders take.
Opening dates for 2021 and 2022 not found; closing dates for 2021, 2023 and 2025 not found.
The text of the District Magistrate's order of 3 July 2026 was not found; it is known only through the traffic advisory.
The daily advisory prints a different highway number from the district order; the district order's number, NH 701A, is used.
The Poonch district page gives an altitude for Pir Ki Gali that looks like a misprint; the encyclopedia figure of 11,480 feet (3,500 metres) is used.
No permit is known to be needed, but no official statement of that was found; identity checks at police posts were not sourced.
No hazard or rule information found for the Bafliaz to Rajouri stretch.
The January 2026 reopening comes from a page that could not be opened.
No rider video newer than 2022 was found; the second video gives no filming date and was published on 28 June 2022.
